adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is published in the swagger; a one-month page answered in ~6 s on 2026-09-25. One request per second.
adapter.terms: eTenders OCDS Public API (National Treasury, South Africa); publication licence per https://data.etenders.gov.za//Home/LearnMore. Bids are submitted to the procuring entity as each tender's documents instruct.

search_postings.note: GET /api/OCDSReleases (PageNumber, PageSize, dateFrom, dateTo — 'dateFrom and dateTo fields are required'). The window is fixed to releases dated from the 1st of the current month (UTC) until now; the API has NO keyword, category or value filter, so query, category and min_budget are not sent — page through and filter on title/description/raw.tender.category/raw.tender.province yourself. OCDS releases: title = tender.title (often the bid number, e.g. NB124/2026), description = tender.description (the subject), buyer = buyer.name, budget_max = tender.value.amount (frequently 0 = not disclosed) in tender.value.currency, posted_at/deadline = tender.tenderPeriod start/end; raw.tender.status tells active from awarded/cancelled, raw.tender.documents link the bid documents and raw.tender.contactPerson the contact.

get_posting.note: GET /api/OCDSReleases/release/{ocid} ('Get OCDS releases by ocid'), id = the ocid from search (e.g. ocds-9t57fa-171582).

not_offered.submit_bid: Read-only OCDS publication API; bids are delivered to the procuring entity (hand delivery or its own channel per tender.specialConditions and the bid documents).
not_offered.bid_status: Read-only OCDS publication API; award outcomes appear later as raw.awards on the release.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging; the API has only the two OCDSReleases GET operations.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging; enquiries go to raw.tender.contactPerson.
